Our Event Planning Process

  1. Discovery

    We learn about your occasion, guests, venue and vision.

  2. Planning

    We propose a menu, service style and timeline for your approval.

  3. Preparation

    Our kitchen prepares your menu and our team readies the setup.

  4. Event Day

    We deliver, set up and serve so you can enjoy your guests.
